description: This file provides utility functions for loading and normalizing file path patterns, especially for CLI-based configurations and environment variables related to test patterns and include patterns. It includes functions to normalize patterns, detect specific pattern types, load pattern lists from files, environment variables, or command-line arguments, and narrow include patterns based on CLI inputs.

methods.name: function normalizeCliPattern(value: string): string { normalizeCliPattern
methods.description: Normalizes CLI pattern strings by trimming, removing leading './' and trailing slashes, and appending default test file glob if they match certain criteria.

methods.name: function looksLikeCliIncludePattern(value: string): boolean { looksLikeCliIncludePattern
methods.description: Determines if a pattern string appears to be a CLI include pattern based on normalization and presence of specific substrings or directory prefixes.

methods.name: export function loadPatternListFile(filePath: string, label: string): string[] { loadPatternListFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file at a given path, ensures it is an array of strings, and filters out empty strings.

methods.name: export function loadPatternListFromEnv( loadPatternListFromEnv
methods.description: Loads a pattern list from an environment variable, reading from a file if present.

methods.name: export function loadPatternListFromArgv(argv: string[] = process.argv): string[] | null { loadPatternListFromArgv
methods.description: Extracts pattern arguments from command-line input, filters, normalizes, and deduplicates them.

methods.name: export function narrowIncludePatternsForCli( narrowIncludePatternsForCli
methods.description: Filters a set of include patterns based on CLI patterns loaded from arguments, matching with glob patterns.
